sentences.japanese: もし君がその橋から落ちるようなことがあれば、君を救うのはほとんど不可能だろう。
sentences.english: If you were to fall from that bridge, it would be almost impossible to rescue you.

sentences.japanese: 金持ちなら貧しい人を救ってやるのだが。
sentences.english: Were I rich, I would help the poor.

sentences.japanese: 環境を救うために、みんなが拠出も含めた協力をしなければならないでしょう。
sentences.english: Everybody will have to pitch in to save the environment.

sentences.japanese: 餓死寸前でいるところを、彼らは私達の命を救ってくれた。
sentences.english: When we were on the brink of starvation, they saved our lives.

sentences.japanese: 何としても彼女を救わねばならない。
sentences.english: I must save her at all costs.
